SETTING A NEW STANDARD

Our Science is Unique

AB combines over 35 years of pioneering research in stem cell science and regenerative medicine with patented TFC™ technologies to deliver clean, high-performance formulations - redefining what skin and hair care can truly achieve.

DISCOVER THE SCIENCE
01.
Patented Technologies

TFC8® and Advanced TFC8® are the patented technologies at the core of every AB formula. Featuring a proprietary peptide and backed by over 35 years of breakthrough research in regenerative medicine, these technologies enhance skin cell communication and create the optimal environment for continuous renewal and visible rejuvenation.

02.
Clinically Proven. Highly Effective.

AB formulas undergo rigorous independent clinical and consumer testing — using instrument and expert grader assessments to validate each claim and ensure measurable results you can see and trust.

03.
Clean & Conscious

Our formulas are composed of carefully selected, clean ingredients that work in harmony with the skin's natural biology, meeting the highest standards of efficacy and safety.
